regime_read: The strongest measured alignment sits in semiconductors and federal technology spending: MU and AMAT combine institutional or insider signals with patent activity, while BAH and IBM show contracting acceleration [insider_mspr] [congress_cluster] [patent_cluster] [gov_contract_accel]. Sentiment-heavy convergence deserves less weight, and PLTR is already extended; with no scored track record, overall conviction remains modest.
regime_read_zh: 目前最强的可测量共振集中在半导体和联邦科技支出：MU与AMAT把机构或内部人信号同专利活动结合起来，BAH与IBM则出现政府合同加速 [insider_mspr] [congress_cluster] [patent_cluster] [gov_contract_accel]。依赖情绪的共振应降低权重，而PLTR已经涨幅过度；由于尚无已评分战绩，整体置信度保持克制。

theses.thesis: MU has the broadest non-extended alignment: accelerating government grants, strongly positive insider-purchase intensity, and a large patent cluster provide three distinct fundamental or positioning signals [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster]. Bullish Stocktwits sentiment and the disclosed Ro Khanna affiliation add corroboration but are weaker evidence [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Ro Khanna].
theses.thesis_zh: MU拥有最广泛且尚未过度延伸的共振：政府补助加速、强劲的内部人买入强度以及大型专利集群，构成三个不同的基本面或持仓信号 [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster]。Stocktwits看多情绪及已披露的Ro Khanna关联提供辅助印证，但证据强度较弱 [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Ro Khanna]。
second_order: Semiconductor-equipment theme — sustained memory investment would support fabrication-tool demand.
HBM and advanced-packaging supply chain — stronger memory demand would increase capacity and packaging requirements.
theses.dissent: The grant amount is modest relative to a large semiconductor manufacturer, while affiliation and retail sentiment may contain little forecasting value.

falsifier.text: Government-grant acceleration reverses and insider-purchase intensity turns non-positive without a corresponding improvement in operating demand.

theses.thesis: AMAT combines purchases disclosed across four congressional members, a substantial patent cluster, and near-unanimous analyst bullishness while trailing SPY over 60 days [congress_cluster] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster]. Unusual options activity adds attention but is not clearly bullish because the reported put/call ratio is slightly above one [unusual_options].
theses.thesis_zh: AMAT同时出现四名国会议员披露的净买入、较大的专利集群以及接近一致的分析师看多，并且过去60日相对SPY落后 [congress_cluster] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster]。异常期权活动增加了关注度，但其看涨含义并不明确，因为披露的看跌/看涨比略高于一 [unusual_options]。
second_order: LRCX — another major wafer-fabrication equipment supplier exposed to the same capacity cycle.
KLAC — process-control demand can benefit when semiconductor fabrication complexity and investment rise.
theses.dissent: Analyst upgrades and congressional disclosures may be stale or crowded, while the options mix does not establish bullish direction.

falsifier.text: Congressional net buying stops and semiconductor-equipment demand weakens despite continued patent activity.

theses.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

theses.thesis: BAH offers a compact federal-spending read: government-contract activity accelerated alongside a reported Trump-linked buy signal and a special-situation flag [gov_contract_accel] [trump] [special_situation]. Its non-extended relative performance leaves an actionable entry, but only three channels are present and two may reflect the same policy backdrop.
theses.thesis_zh: BAH提供了一个较集中的联邦支出信号：政府合同活动加速，同时出现特朗普相关买入信号和特殊事件标记 [gov_contract_accel] [trump] [special_situation]。其相对表现尚未过度延伸，仍具备可操作入口，但仅有三个渠道，而且其中两个可能反映同一政策背景。
second_order: PLTR — federal technology procurement can support adjacent data and analytics vendors, though its shares are already extended.
Federal IT-services theme — broader agency modernization and enforcement spending can lift sector backlogs.
theses.dissent: Contract acceleration may be episodic, and the Trump-linked and special-situation signals are not independently quantified operating evidence.

falsifier.text: Federal contract awards normalize without translating into sustained backlog or revenue momentum.

theses.thesis: IBM's sharp government-contract acceleration aligns with the pack's largest patent count and measurable open-source momentum [gov_contract_accel] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum]. Its substantial 60-day underperformance means the signal is not being chased, but the extreme acceleration reading may be distorted by a very small comparison base.
theses.thesis_zh: IBM政府合同的显著加速，与本证据包中最高的专利数量及可测量的开源动能形成共振 [gov_contract_accel] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum]。其过去60日大幅跑输，因此并非追高交易；但极端的加速读数可能受到较低比较基数的扭曲。
second_order: BAH — broader federal technology spending can support adjacent government-services contractors.
Enterprise AI infrastructure theme — deployment activity can benefit hybrid-cloud, consulting and systems-integration demand.
theses.dissent: Patents and GitHub activity may not monetize, while the contract-growth multiple is vulnerable to base effects and an earnings event is near.

falsifier.text: Government-contract momentum falls back toward its prior pace and open-source activity fails to produce commercial demand.

theses.thesis: PLTR has genuine operating-plus-positioning convergence through accelerating government contracts, unanimous analyst bullishness, disclosed political and fund links, and strong retail sentiment [gov_contract_accel] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]. However, it is explicitly extended after materially outperforming SPY, so the evidence supports WATCH rather than a new accumulation entry.
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR呈现真实的经营与持仓共振，包括政府合同加速、分析师一致看多、已披露的政治人物及基金关联，以及强劲的散户情绪 [gov_contract_accel] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]。但其相对SPY已大幅跑赢并被明确标记为过度延伸，因此证据仅支持观察，而不支持新增加仓。
second_order: BAH — federal procurement strength can spill into adjacent government consulting and implementation work.
IBM — federal data modernization can support established enterprise infrastructure and services providers.
theses.dissent: Retail enthusiasm, unanimous analyst sentiment and fund affiliation create crowding risk, while the extended price already discounts substantial contract growth.

falsifier.text: Government-contract acceleration reverses while retail bullishness remains elevated and price leadership breaks down.
